Apple (AAPL) Market Value Rose While Graybill Bartz & Assoc LTD Has Trimmed Its Stake; As Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Market Value Rose, Holder Bellecapital International LTD Has Raised Its Position
June 24, 2018 - By Jonathan Benavides
Bellecapital International Ltd increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 89.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bellecapital International Ltd bought 23,304 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 49,214 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.19M, up from 25,910 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bellecapital International Ltd who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $92.22B market cap company. It closed at $66.58 lastly. It is down 1.14% since June 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.71% the S&P500. Graybill Bartz & Assoc Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.13% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 29,493 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.95M, down from 31,759 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Graybill Bartz & Assoc Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $908.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.11 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
